user_addresses:
CREATE TABLE `user_addresses` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '地址编号',
  `user_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '所属用户编号',
  `recipient_name` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '收货人',
  `phone` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '联系电话',
  `province` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '省或直辖市',
  `city` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '城市',
  `district` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '区县',
  `detail_address` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '详细地址',
  `is_default` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '1默认，0非默认',
  `default_user_id` bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`is_default` = 1) then `user_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_user_addresses_default` (`default_user_id`),
  KEY `idx_user_addresses_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_user_addresses_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `app_users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_user_addresses_default` CHECK ((`is_default` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_user_addresses_text` CHECK (((char_length(trim(`recipient_name`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`phone`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`province`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`city`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`district`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`detail_address`)) > 0)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户收货地址'
product_inventory:
CREATE TABLE `product_inventory` (
  `product_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `available_quantity` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reserved_quantity` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_product_inventory_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_product_inventory_available` CHECK ((`available_quantity` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_product_inventory_reserved` CHECK ((`reserved_quantity` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
shop_orders:
CREATE TABLE `shop_orders` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `request_key` varchar(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `request_hash` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_PAYMENT',
  `total_amount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `recipient_name` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `province` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `city` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `district` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `detail_address` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `paid_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `closed_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_shop_orders_user_request` (`user_id`,`request_key`),
  KEY `idx_shop_orders_user_id` (`user_id`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_shop_orders_expiry` (`status`,`expires_at`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_shop_orders_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `app_users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_shop_orders_address` CHECK (((char_length(trim(`recipient_name`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`phone`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`province`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`city`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`district`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`detail_address`)) > 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_shop_orders_amount` CHECK ((`total_amount` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_shop_orders_expiry` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_shop_orders_request` CHECK (((char_length(`request_key`) = 36) and (char_length(`request_hash`) = 64))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_shop_orders_state_time` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'PENDING_PAYMENT') and (`paid_at` is null) and (`closed_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'PAID') and (`paid_at` is not null) and (`paid_at` >= `created_at`) and (`closed_at` is null)) or ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'CANCELLED',_utf8mb4'EXPIRED')) and (`paid_at` is null) and (`closed_at` is not null) and (`closed_at` >= `created_at`)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_shop_orders_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING_PAYMENT',_utf8mb4'PAID',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED',_utf8mb4'EXPIRED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
order_items:
CREATE TABLE `order_items` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `order_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `product_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `brand` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `image_url` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `unit_price` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `quantity` int NOT NULL,
  `line_amount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_order_items_order_product` (`order_id`,`product_id`),
  KEY `idx_order_items_product` (`product_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_order_items_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `shop_orders` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_order_items_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_order_items_amount` CHECK ((`line_amount` = (`unit_price` * `quantity`))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_order_items_price` CHECK ((`unit_price` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_order_items_quantity` CHECK ((`quantity` between 1 and 99)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_order_items_text` CHECK (((char_length(trim(`title`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`brand`)) > 0)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
payment_attempts:
CREATE TABLE `payment_attempts` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `order_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `request_key` varchar(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `channel` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MOCK',
  `status` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `amount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `finished_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `active_order_id` bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` = _ascii'PENDING') then `order_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `successful_order_id` bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` = _ascii'SUCCEEDED') then `order_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `out_trade_no` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `provider_app_id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `provider_seller_id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `provider_trade_no` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `provider_paid_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_payment_attempts_order_request` (`order_id`,`request_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_payment_attempts_active` (`active_order_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_payment_attempts_success` (`successful_order_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_payment_attempts_out_trade` (`out_trade_no`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_payment_attempts_provider_trade` (`channel`,`provider_trade_no`),
  KEY `idx_payment_attempts_order_id` (`order_id`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_payment_attempts_expiry` (`status`,`expires_at`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_payment_attempts_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `shop_orders` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_attempts_amount` CHECK ((`amount` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_attempts_channel` CHECK ((`channel` in (_utf8mb4'MOCK',_utf8mb4'ALIPAY_SANDBOX'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_attempts_expiry` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_attempts_provider_identity` CHECK ((((`channel` = _utf8mb4'MOCK') and (`out_trade_no` is null) and (`provider_app_id` is null) and (`provider_seller_id` is null) and (`provider_trade_no` is null) and (`provider_paid_at` is null)) or ((`channel` = _utf8mb4'ALIPAY_SANDBOX') and (`out_trade_no` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`out_trade_no`)) > 0) and (`provider_app_id` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`provider_app_id`)) > 0) and (`provider_seller_id` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`provider_seller_id`)) > 0)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_attempts_provider_success` CHECK (((`channel` = _utf8mb4'MOCK') or (`status` <> _utf8mb4'SUCCEEDED') or ((`provider_trade_no` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`provider_trade_no`)) > 0) and (`provider_paid_at` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_attempts_request` CHECK ((char_length(`request_key`) = 36)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_attempts_state_time` CHECK ((((`status` = _ascii'PENDING') and (`finished_at` is null)) or ((`status` in (_ascii'SUCCEEDED',_ascii'FAILED',_ascii'CLOSED')) and (`finished_at` is not null) and (`finished_at` >= `created_at`)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_attempts_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_ascii'PENDING',_ascii'SUCCEEDED',_ascii'FAILED',_ascii'CLOSED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
mock_payment_receipts:
CREATE TABLE `mock_payment_receipts` (
  `payment_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `order_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `outcome` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`payment_id`),
  KEY `fk_mock_payment_receipts_order` (`order_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_mock_payment_receipts_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `shop_orders` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_mock_payment_receipts_payment` FOREIGN KEY (`payment_id`) REFERENCES `payment_attempts` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_mock_payment_receipts_amount` CHECK ((`amount` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_mock_payment_receipts_outcome` CHECK ((`outcome` in (_utf8mb4'SUCCEEDED',_utf8mb4'FAILED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
